en.s: The Battle of Ad Decimum took place on 13 September 533 between the armies of the Vandals, commanded by King Gelimer, and the Byzantine Empire, under the command of General Belisarius. The Vandal Kingdom under King Hilderic maintained close ties with Emperor Justinian I, but Hilderic's acceptance of Chalcedonian Christianity over Arianism led to his overthrow by his cousin Gelimer in 531.

zh.s: 阿德德西穆姆战役于533年9月13日爆发，交战双方是汪达尔国王盖利梅尔指挥的汪达尔军队与贝利撒留将军指挥的拜占庭军队。希尔德里克统治下的汪达尔王国与查士丁尼一世皇帝关系密切，但希尔德里克接受迦克墩派基督教而非阿里乌派后，于531年被其表兄盖利梅尔推翻。

en.s: The Battle of Ballaghmoon (Irish: Cath Bealaigh Mughna) took place on 13 September 908 at Ballaghmoon, near Castledermot in the south of modern County Kildare. It pitted the forces of Cormac mac Cuilennáin, king of Munster against a alliance comprising the forces of Flann Sinna, high king of Ireland, Cerball mac Muirecáin, king of Leinster, Cathal mac Conchobair, king of Connacht, and Cellach mac Cerbaill, king of Osraige. It ended in a decisive victory for the alliance led by Flann Sinna. The Conflict arose after Cormac mac Cuilennáin assembled an army to campaign against his eastern neighbour, Leinster, whose king Cerball mac Muirecáin was Flann Sinna's son-in-law and staunch ally.

zh.s: 巴拉赫穆恩战役于908年9月13日在巴拉赫穆恩爆发，地点靠近卡斯尔德莫特，位于今基尔代尔郡南部。交战一方是明斯特国王科马克·马克·库伦南的军队，另一方是由爱尔兰最高王弗兰·辛纳、伦斯特国王塞尔巴尔·马克·穆伊雷凯因、康诺特国王卡塔尔·马克·康霍拜尔和奥索里国王凯拉赫·马克·凯尔拜尔组成的联盟。战役以弗兰·辛纳领导的联盟大胜告终。起因是科马克·马克·库伦南集结军队，准备进攻东邻伦斯特；伦斯特国王塞尔巴尔·马克·穆伊雷凯因是弗兰·辛纳的女婿，也是他的坚定盟友。

en.s: The Battle of Saruj was a military engagement between the Atruqid Turks and the Crusader County of Edessa. The Atruqids, led by Belek Ghazi, defeated and captured Joscelin I, Count of Edessa.

zh.s: 萨鲁季战役是阿尔图格突厥人与十字军建立的埃德萨伯国之间的一场军事交战。阿尔图格军由贝莱克·加齐率领，击败并俘虏了埃德萨伯爵约斯林一世。

en.t: Ögedei Khan is proclaimed Khagan of the Mongol Empire in Kodoe Aral, Khentii: Mongolia
en.s: Ögedei Khan (also Ögedei Khagan or Ogodei; c. 1186 – 11 December 1241) was the second khan of the Mongol Empire. The third son of Genghis Khan, he continued the expansion of the empire that his father had begun. Born in c. 1186 AD, Ögedei fought in numerous battles during his father's rise to power.

zh.t: 窝阔台在蒙古肯特省科多阿拉尔被推举为蒙古帝国大汗
zh.s: 窝阔台汗（亦称窝阔台合罕或斡歌歹；约1186年—1241年12月11日）是蒙古帝国第二位大汗，成吉思汗第三子。他延续了父亲开创的帝国扩张事业。窝阔台约生于公元1186年，在父亲崛起期间参加过多场战役。

en.s: The Battle of Tangier, sometimes referred to as the siege of Tangiers, and by the Portuguese, as the disaster of Tangier (Portuguese: Desastre de Tânger), refers to the attempt by a Portuguese expeditionary force to seize the Moroccan citadel of Tangier and its defeat by the armies of the Marinid Sultanate in 1437.

zh.s: 丹吉尔战役有时也称丹吉尔围城战，葡萄牙人称之为“丹吉尔灾难”（葡萄牙语：Desastre de Tânger）。1437年，葡萄牙远征军试图夺取摩洛哥的丹吉尔城堡，最终被马林王朝苏丹国军队击败。

en.s: The Capture of Mers-el-Kébir on September 13, 1505 was the first campaign carried out by the Spanish Empire in its war against the Zayyanid Kingdom of Tlemcen (in modern Algeria). Mers-el-Kébir (Spanish: Mazalquivir) was a roadstead open to the southwest winds, and a refuge for corsairs. The port was protected by a strong and well-armed castle, and it had already been unsuccessfully attacked by Portuguese troops in 1496 and 1501.

zh.s: 西班牙帝国于1505年9月13日发起夺取梅尔斯埃尔凯比尔的战役，这是其对特莱姆森扎扬王朝开战后的首次军事行动。梅尔斯埃尔凯比尔（西班牙语：Mazalquivir）是一处向西南风敞开的锚地，也是海盗船的避风港。港口由一座坚固且装备精良的城堡防守，葡萄牙军队曾于1496年和1501年两度进攻，均未成功。

en.s: The conquest of Tunis in 1574 marked the conquest of Tunis by the Ottoman Empire over the Spanish Empire, which had seized the place a year earlier. The event virtually determined the supremacy in North Africa vied between both empires in favour of the former, sealing the Ottoman domination over eastern and central Maghreb, with the Ottoman dependencies in Algiers, Tunis and Tripoli ensuing coming to experience a golden age as corsair states.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1574年，奥斯曼帝国从西班牙帝国手中夺取突尼斯；西班牙此前一年占领了该地。此次征服基本确定了两大帝国在北非争夺的主导地位将归奥斯曼帝国，并巩固了奥斯曼对马格里布东部和中部的统治。此后，奥斯曼属地阿尔及尔、突尼斯和的黎波里进入海盗国家的鼎盛时期。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件结束日期。

en.s: The naval Battle of the Slaak (12 and 13 September 1631) was a Dutch victory during the Eighty Years' War. The Dutch prevented the Spanish army from dividing the Dutch United Provinces in two.

zh.s: 斯拉克海战于1631年9月12日至13日爆发，是八十年战争期间荷兰的一场胜仗。荷兰人阻止了西班牙军队将荷兰联省共和国一分为二。

en.s: The Battle of Aberdeen, also known as the Battle of Justice Mills and the Crabstane Rout, was an engagement in the Wars of the Three Kingdoms which took place outside the city of Aberdeen on 13 September 1644. During the battle, Royalist forces led by James Graham, Lord Montrose routed an army raised by the Covenanter-dominated Parliament of Scotland under Robert Balfour, 2nd Lord Balfour of Burleigh.

zh.s: 阿伯丁战役也称正义磨坊战役或蟹石溃败，是三王国战争期间的一场战斗，于1644年9月13日在阿伯丁城外爆发。蒙特罗斯勋爵詹姆斯·格雷厄姆率领的保王军击溃了苏格兰议会军；议会军由罗伯特·巴尔弗、第二代巴尔弗·伯利勋爵指挥，主要由圣约派支持者招募组成。

en.s: The Battle of Philiphaugh was fought on 13 September 1645 during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms near Selkirk in the Scottish Borders. The Royalist army of the Marquis of Montrose was destroyed by the Covenanter army of Sir David Leslie, restoring the power of the Committee of Estates.

zh.s: 菲利普霍战役于1645年9月13日在三王国战争期间爆发，地点靠近苏格兰边境地区的塞尔柯克。蒙特罗斯侯爵率领的保王军被戴维·莱斯利爵士指挥的圣约盟军彻底击溃，地产委员会因此恢复了权力。

en.s: The indecisive naval battle of Møn was a battle during the Dano-Swedish War (1657–1658). A large number of ships was involved, but the fight was not very intense.

zh.s: 蒙岛海战是丹麦—瑞典战争（1657—1658年）期间的一场海战，结果未分胜负。参战船只很多，但战斗并不激烈。

en.s: The Battle of Pererîta was a clash between the troops of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Turkish–Tatar detachments on 13 September 1691 in the village of Pererîta, located in present-day Moldova. The battle was part of the Polish campaign against Moldavia, taking place within the broader context of the Polish–Ottoman War (1683–1699) and the Great Turkish War, and resulted in a Polish–Lithuanian victory.

zh.s: 佩雷里塔战役于1691年9月13日在今摩尔多瓦境内的佩雷里塔村爆发，交战双方是波兰立陶宛联邦军队与土耳其—鞑靼分遣部队。此役是波兰对摩尔达维亚战役的一部分，也处于波兰—奥斯曼战争（1683—1699年）和大土耳其战争的更大背景之中，最终以波兰立陶宛联邦获胜告终。

en.s: The Treaty of Worms was a political alliance formed between Great Britain, Austria and the Kingdom of Sardinia, signed on 13 September 1743, during the War of the Austrian Succession. It was an ambitious piece of foreign policy on the part of the British government which sought to split the Emperor Charles VII, prince-elector of Bavaria, from French influence, whilst simultaneously resolving the differences between the Emperor, Queen Maria Theresa of Hungary and King Charles Emmanuel III of Sardinia.

zh.s: 《沃尔姆斯条约》是英国、奥地利和撒丁王国缔结的一项政治同盟，于奥地利王位继承战争期间的1743年9月13日签署。英国政府希望借此外交举措使巴伐利亚选帝侯、皇帝查理七世脱离法国影响，同时解决查理七世、匈牙利女王玛丽亚·特蕾莎和撒丁国王查理·埃曼努埃莱三世之间的分歧。

en.s: The 1745 imperial election was held on (13 September 1745) in Frankfurt am Main to elect the new Holy Roman Emperor following the death of Emperor Charles VII. Francis Stephen of Lorraine was elected, restoring the Habsburg dynasty to the imperial throne.

zh.s: 1745年9月13日，法兰克福举行帝国选举，以选出查理七世去世后的新任神圣罗马帝国皇帝。洛林的弗朗茨·斯蒂芬当选，哈布斯堡王朝由此重新登上帝位。

en.s: The Pomeranian War was a theatre of the Seven Years' War. The term is used to describe the fighting between Sweden and Prussia between 1757 and 1762 in Swedish Pomerania, Prussian Pomerania, northern Brandenburg and eastern Mecklenburg-Schwerin. The war was characterized by a back-and-forth movement of the Swedish and Prussian armies, neither of whom would score a decisive victory.

zh.s: 波美拉尼亚战争是七年战争中的一个战场，指1757年至1762年间瑞典与普鲁士在瑞典波美拉尼亚、普鲁士波美拉尼亚、勃兰登堡北部和梅克伦堡—施特雷利茨东部之间的战斗。战争期间，瑞典和普鲁士军队多次往返推进，双方都未取得决定性胜利。

en.t: Battle of the Plains of Abraham
en.s: The Battle of the Plains of Abraham, also known as the Battle of Quebec, (Bataille des Plaines d'Abraham or Première bataille de Québec in French) was a pivotal battle in the Seven Years' War (referred to as the French and Indian War in the United States). The battle, which began on 13 September 1759, was fought by the British Army and Navy against the French Army on a plateau just outside the walls of Quebec City, on land that was originally owned by a farmer named Abraham Martin, hence the name of the battle.

zh.s: 亚伯拉罕平原战役又称魁北克战役，是七年战争中的关键战役；在美国，这场战争也称法国与印第安人战争。1759年9月13日，英国陆海军与法国陆军在魁北克城城墙外的一处高原交战。战场原属农民亚伯拉罕·马丁，因此得名。

en.s: The Boyd and Parker ambush was a minor military engagement in what is now Groveland, New York, on September 13, 1779, during the American Revolutionary War. A scouting patrol of the Sullivan Expedition was ambushed by Loyalist soldiers, led by Major John Butler, and their Seneca allies, led by Cornplanter and Little Beard.

zh.s: 博伊德与帕克伏击战是美国独立战争期间的一场小规模军事交战，于1779年9月13日在今纽约州格罗夫兰一带发生。萨利文远征军的一支侦察巡逻队遭到保王党士兵伏击。伏击者由约翰·巴特勒少校率领，并有康普兰特和小胡子率领的塞内卡盟友参加。

en.s: The Battle of Lindley's Mill (also known as the Battle of Cane Creek) took place in Orange County, North Carolina (now in Alamance County), on September 13, 1781, during the American Revolutionary War. The battle took its name from a mill that sat at the site of the battle on Cane Creek, which sat along a road connecting what was then the temporary state capital, Hillsborough, with Wilmington, North Carolina.

zh.s: 林德利磨坊战役也称凯恩溪战役，于1781年9月13日在北卡罗来纳州奥兰治县（今阿拉曼斯县）爆发，是美国独立战争期间的一场战斗。战役名称来自凯恩溪边的一座磨坊；磨坊位于一条道路旁，这条路连接当时的临时州府希尔斯伯勒和北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿。

en.s: The Great Siege of Gibraltar was an unsuccessful attempt by Spain and France to capture Gibraltar from Britain during the American Revolutionary War. It was the largest battle in the war by number of combatants. On 16 June 1779, Spain entered the war on the side of France with the primary war aim of capturing Gibraltar from the British.
en.n: American Revolutionary War: Franco-Spanish troops launch the unsuccessful "grand assault" during the Great Siege of Gibraltar.

zh.s: 直布罗陀大围城战是美国独立战争期间西班牙和法国试图从英国手中夺取直布罗陀、但最终未能成功的一次行动。按参战人数计算，这是该战争中规模最大的一场战役。1779年6月16日，西班牙加入法国一方参战，主要目标是从英国手中夺取直布罗陀。
zh.n: 美国独立战争期间，法西联军在直布罗陀大围城战中发动未遂的“大突击”。

en.s: The Battle of Menin, or of Wervik and Menen was fought on 12 and 13 September 1793 between 30,000 men of the French Army of the North commanded by Jean Nicolas Houchard, and 13,000 Coalition troops: the veldleger (mobile army) of the Dutch States Army, commanded by the William, Hereditary Prince of Orange and his brother Prince Frederick of Orange-Nassau, and a few squadrons of Austrian cavalry under Pál Kray, seconded by Johann Peter Beaulieu. The great superiority in numbers being on the French side the battle ended in a victory for France, with the Dutch army suffering heavy losses.

zh.s: 梅宁战役（又称韦尔维克—梅宁战役）于1793年9月12日至13日爆发。法国北方军团由让-尼古拉·乌沙尔指挥，共有3万人；对手是荷兰联省共和国军的机动部队，由奥兰治世袭亲王威廉及其弟腓特烈亲王指挥，另有帕尔·克雷指挥、约翰·彼得·博利厄配属的奥地利骑兵中少数中队，总计1.3万人。法军在人数量上占有明显优势，最终获胜，荷兰军损失惨重。

en.s: The siege of Le Quesnoy (28 August – 13 September 1793) saw a force made up of Habsburg Austrians and French Royalists led by François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt lay siege to a Republican French garrison commanded by François Goullus. After two and a half week siege, the French capitulated after suffering heavy losses.

zh.s: 勒凯努瓦围城战发生于1793年8月28日至9月13日。弗朗索瓦·塞巴斯蒂安·夏尔·约瑟夫·德·克鲁瓦伯爵（克莱尔费特伯爵）率领哈布斯堡奥地利军和法国保王党军围攻弗朗索瓦·古吕斯指挥的共和派法军守军。经过两个半星期的围城，法军伤亡惨重后投降。

en.t: Beethoven's Mass in C major, Op. 86, is premiered, commissioned by Nikolaus I, Prince Esterházy, and displeasing him
en.s: Ludwig van Beethoven composed the Mass in C major, Op. 86, to a commission from Prince Nikolaus Esterházy II in 1807. The mass, scored for four vocal soloists, choir and orchestra, was premiered that year by the Prince's musical forces in Eisenstadt. Beethoven performed parts of it in his 1808 concert featuring the premieres of four major works including his Fifth Symphony.

zh.t: 贝多芬《C大调弥撒曲》（作品86）首演
zh.s: 路德维希·范·贝多芬受埃斯特哈齐二世亲王尼古拉斯委托，于1807年创作《C大调弥撒曲》（作品86）。这部作品为四位独唱者、合唱团和管弦乐队而作，并于当年由亲王的乐团在艾森施塔特首演。贝多芬在1808年的音乐会上演奏了其中部分乐章；那场音乐会还首演了包括《第五交响曲》在内的四部重要作品。

en.s: The Battle of Jutas (Finnish: Juuttaan taistelu, Swedish: Slaget vid Jutas) was fought on September 13, 1808 between Swedish and Russian troops south of Nykarleby in Ostrobothnia, Finland. Before the battle the Swedish army was in retreat after the campaign of the previous summer. The main Swedish force was retreating from Vaasa to Nykarleby. The Russians sent a force to cut off the Swedish retreat. In response the Swedes sent a force under Georg Carl von Döbeln to intercept them. The battle ended in a Swedish victory, but the main Swedish army was beaten in the Battle of Oravais the very next day.

zh.s: 尤塔斯战役（芬兰语：Juuttaan taistelu；瑞典语：Slaget vid Jutas）于1808年9月13日在芬兰博滕区纽卡勒比以南爆发，交战双方是瑞典和俄国军队。此前，瑞典军队在前一年夏季的战役后一直撤退，主力正从瓦萨撤往纽卡勒比。俄军派兵试图切断瑞军退路，瑞军则派乔治·卡尔·冯·德贝恩率部拦截。瑞军赢得此役，但主力部队第二天在奥拉瓦伊斯战役中战败。

en.s: The action of 13 September 1810 was an frigate engagement during the Napoleonic Wars between Royal Navy and French Imperial Navy frigates during which a British frigate was defeated by two French vessels near Isle de France (now Mauritius), but British reinforcements were able to recapture the ship before the French could secure her. The British frigate was HMS Africaine, a new arrival to the Indian Ocean.

zh.s: 1810年9月13日海战是拿破仑战争期间的一场护卫舰交战，交战双方为英国皇家海军和法国帝国海军。战斗发生在法兰西岛（今毛里求斯）附近，一艘英国护卫舰被两艘法国舰船击败，但英国增援部队在法军控制舰船前将其夺回。该英国护卫舰为新近抵达印度洋的“非洲人”号。

en.s: The Battle of Ordal on 12 and 13 September 1813 saw a First French Empire corps led by Marshal Louis Gabriel Suchet make a night assault on a position held by Lieutenant General Lord William Bentinck's smaller Anglo-Allied and Spanish advance guard. The Allies, under the tactical direction of Colonel Frederick Adam, were defeated and driven from a strong position at the Ordal defile largely because they failed to post adequate pickets. In an action the next morning at Vilafranca del Penedès, the Allied cavalry clashed with the pursuing French horsemen. The actions occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

en.s: The Battle of Chapultepec took place between U.S. troops and Mexican forces holding the strategically located Chapultepec Castle on the outskirts of Mexico City on September 13, 1847 during the Mexican–American War. en.t: 1932 United States Senate election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1932 United States Senate election in South Carolina was held on November 8. On September 13, incumbent Senator Ellison D. Smith defeated former Senator Cole Blease in the Democratic primary with 56.7% of the vote. At this time, South Carolina was a one-party state, and the Democratic nomination was tantamount to victory. Smith won the November general election without any effort.

zh.t: 1932年南卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举的大选于11月8日举行。9月13日，民主党初选中，现任参议员埃里森·D·史密斯以56.7%的得票率击败前参议员科尔·布利斯。当时南卡罗来纳州实行一党制，赢得民主党提名就等同于当选。史密斯后来在11月的大选中轻松获胜。

en.s: The Lyttelton by-election of 1933 was a by-election held during the 24th New Zealand Parliament in the Christchurch electorate of Lyttelton. It is notable for being won by Elizabeth McCombs of the New Zealand Labour Party, who became the first woman to be elected to the New Zealand Parliament. This by-election was therefore seen as a milestone in Women's suffrage in New Zealand.

zh.s: 1933年利特尔顿补选是在新西兰第24届议会期间、于利特尔顿选区举行的一次补选。新西兰工党候选人伊丽莎白·麦科姆斯赢得选举，成为首位当选新西兰国会议员的女性。这次补选因此被视为新西兰女性选举权发展史上的一个里程碑。

en.t: 1939 Country Party of Australia leadership election
en.s: A leadership election was held on 13 September 1939 to select Earle Page's replacement as leader of the Country Party of Australia and de facto-Deputy Prime Minister. Archie Cameron was elected party leader in preference to John McEwen seven votes to five.

zh.t: 1939年澳大利亚乡村党领袖选举
zh.s: 1939年9月13日，澳大利亚乡村党举行党魁选举，选出厄尔·佩奇的继任者。佩奇此前同时担任党魁和事实上的副总理。阿奇·卡梅伦以7票对5票击败约翰·麦克尤恩，当选党魁。

en.s: The Battle of Edson's Ridge, also known as the Battle of the Bloody Ridge, Battle of Raiders Ridge, and Battle of the Ridge, was a land battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Army and Allied (mainly United States Marine Corps) ground forces. It took place from 12 to 14 September 1942, on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, and was the second of three separate major Japanese ground offensives during the Guadalcanal campaign.
en.n: World War II: Second day of the Battle of Edson's Ridge in the Guadalcanal Campaign. U.S. Marines successfully defeat attacks by the Japanese with heavy losses for the Japanese forces.

zh.s: 埃德森山脊战役也称血腥山脊战役、突击队员山脊战役或山脊战役，是第二次世界大战太平洋战场上的一场陆战，交战双方是日本帝国陆军与盟军地面部队（主要是美国海军陆战队）。战役于1942年9月12日至14日在所罗门群岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛进行，是瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役期间日军三次主要地面攻势中的第二次。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：瓜达尔卡纳尔岛战役期间，埃德森山脊战役进入第二天。美国海军陆战队成功击退日军进攻，日军损失惨重。

en.s: Operation Aquatint was the codename for a failed raid by British Commandos on the coast of occupied France during the Second World War. The raid was undertaken in September 1942 on part of what later became Omaha Beach by No. 62 Commando, also known as the Small Scale Raiding Force.

en.s: The Battle of Meligalas (Greek: Μάχη του Μελιγαλά, romanized: Machi tou Meligala) took place during the Axis occupation of Greece in Meligalas in southwestern Greece on 13–15 September 1944. Greek Resistance forces of the Greek People's Liberation Army (ELAS) defeated a Security Battalion garrison loyal to the collaborationist government.

zh.s: 梅利加拉斯战役于1944年9月13日至15日希腊被轴心国占领期间，在希腊西南部的梅利加拉斯爆发。希腊人民解放军（ELAS）的抵抗力量击败了效忠于通敌政府的安全营驻军。

en.s: The Battle of Dompaire was fought between French and German armoured forces near the town of Dompaire in France. It took place between 12 and 14 September 1944 during the Lorraine campaign on the Western Front of World War II. The battle saw a new German Panzer brigade hastily set up by the Wehrmacht to stop the Allied advance after the collapse of the Normandy front, and a unit of the French 2nd Armoured Division under General Philippe Leclerc.

zh.s: 栋佩尔战役是法国与德国装甲部队在法国栋佩尔镇附近进行的一场战斗，发生于1944年9月12日至14日，是第二次世界大战西线洛林战役的一部分。德军在诺曼底战线崩溃后仓促组建新的装甲旅，试图阻止盟军推进；法军方面则由菲利普·勒克莱尔将军指挥的法国第二装甲师参战。

en.s: The Wudi Campaign (无棣战役) was a campaign fought in Wudi County in northern Shandong, and it was a clash between the communists and the former nationalists turned Japanese puppet regime force who rejoined the nationalists after World War II. The battle was one of the battles of the Chinese Civil War in the immediate post World War II era, and resulted in communist victory.

en.s: The 1948 Maine gubernatorial election took place on September 13, 1948. Incumbent Republican Governor Horace A. Hildreth, was term limited and seeking election to the United States Senate (eventually losing the Republican Primary to Margaret Chase Smith), thus did not run. Republican mayor of Augusta Frederick G. Payne faced off against Democratic challenger Louis B. Lausier, defeating him in a landslide.

zh.s: 1948年缅因州州长选举于9月13日举行。共和党籍现任州长霍勒斯·A·希尔德雷思因任期限制无法连任，转而竞选美国参议员（后来在共和党初选中败给玛格丽特·蔡斯·史密斯），因此没有参加州长选举。共和党籍奥古斯塔市长弗雷德里克·G·佩恩与民主党候选人路易斯·B·劳西耶对决，并以压倒性优势获胜。

en.t: 1948 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 1948 United States Senate election in Maine was held on September 13, 1948. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator and Senate Majority Leader Wallace White did not seek a fourth term in office. U.S. Representative Margaret Chase Smith defeated the two most recent Governors of Maine, Horace Hildreth and Sumner Sewall, in the Republican primary. In the general election, Smith resoundingly defeated Democrat Adrian Scolten of Portland.

zh.s: 1948年缅因州美国参议院选举于9月13日举行。共和党籍现任参议员、参议院多数党领袖华莱士·怀特没有竞选第四个任期。共和党初选中，联邦众议员玛格丽特·蔡斯·史密斯击败了缅因州最近两任州长霍勒斯·希尔德雷思和萨姆纳·休厄尔。大选中，史密斯以明显优势击败来自波特兰的民主党候选人阿德里安·斯科尔滕。

en.s: The annexation of Hyderabad (code-named Operation Polo) was a military operation launched in September 1948 that resulted in the annexation of the princely state of Hyderabad by India, which was dubbed a "police action". At the time of partition of India in 1947, the princely states of India, who in principle had self-government within their territories, were subject to subsidiary alliances with the British, which gave control of external relations to the British.

en.s: The 1954 Maine gubernatorial election took place on September 13, 1954. Incumbent Republican Governor Burton M. Cross was seeking a second term which would have made him the fifth consecutive Governor (all Republicans) to be elected twice. Democratic state representative Edmund Muskie, widely viewed as the underdog due to Maine's solidly Republican history, was able to pull an upset victory and become the first Democrat to be elected to the Blaine House since Louis J. Brann in 1934. His election is widely viewed as the beginning of the rise of the Democratic Party in Maine, and the end of Republican dominance in the state.

zh.s: 1954年缅因州州长选举于1954年9月13日举行。共和党籍现任州长伯顿·M·克罗斯竞选连任；若当选，他将成为连续第五位连任的州长，而且这五人都将是共和党人。民主党州众议员埃德蒙·马斯基原本被普遍看作胜算较低，但最终意外获胜，成为自1934年路易斯·J·布兰之后首位当选缅因州州长的民主党人。这场胜选被普遍视为缅因州民主党崛起和共和党长期主导局面结束的开端。

en.t: The IBM 305 RAMAC is introduced, the first commercial computer to use disk storage
en.s: The IBM 305 RAMAC was the first commercial computer that used a moving-head hard disk drive (magnetic disk storage) for secondary storage. The system was publicly announced on September 14, 1956, with test units already installed at the U.S. Navy and at private corporations. RAMAC stood for "Random Access Method of Accounting and Control", as its design was motivated by the need for real-time accounting in business.

zh.t: IBM推出305 RAMAC，首款采用磁盘存储的商用计算机
zh.s: IBM 305 RAMAC是首款使用移动磁头硬盘驱动器（磁盘存储）作为辅助存储设备的商用计算机。该系统于1956年9月14日公开发布，当时美国海军和多家私营企业已安装测试机。RAMAC是“随机存取会计与控制方法”（Random Access Method of Accounting and Control）的缩写，其设计旨在满足企业实时会计需求。

Mayo, playing in their first (and, as of 2011, only) All-Ireland final, were well off the pace, and only managed one point in the first half.

zh.t: 1959年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1959年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是第28届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1959年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛的冠军决胜赛。该锦标赛由爱尔兰各郡的顶级球队参加。马约队首次打进全爱尔兰决赛；截至2011年，这也是该队唯一一次进入决赛。不过马约队明显处于下风，上半场只得到1分。

en.s: The 1961 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1960–61 DFB-Pokal, the 18th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 13 September 1961 at the Glückauf-Kampfbahn in Gelsenkirchen. Werder Bremen won the match 2–0 against 1. FC Kaiserslautern, to claim their 1st cup title.

zh.s: 1961年德国杯决赛决出了1960—61赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国淘汰赛制足球杯赛的第18个赛季。比赛于1961年9月13日在盖尔森基兴的格吕克奥夫球场举行。云达不来梅以2比0击败凯泽斯劳滕，首次夺得德国杯冠军。

en.s: General elections were held in Grenada on 13 September 1962. Herbert Blaize's Grenada National Party won six of the ten seats and Blaize was appointed Chief Minister for the second time. Blaize served as Head of Government until the next general election in August 1967, initially as Chief Minister until March 1967, and subsequently when Grenada became a fully internally autonomous Associated State, as Grenada's first Premier.

zh.s: 格林纳达于1962年9月13日举行大选。赫伯特·布莱兹领导的格林纳达民族党赢得10个席位中的6席，布莱兹第二次获任首席部长。他一直执政至1967年8月的下届大选；1967年3月格林纳达成为内部完全自治的联系邦后，他改任格林纳达首任总理。

en.s: Before dawn on September 13, 1964, the ruling military junta of South Vietnam, led by General Nguyễn Khánh, was threatened by a coup attempt headed by Generals Lâm Văn Phát and Dương Văn Đức, who sent dissident units into the capital Saigon. They captured various key points and announced over national radio the overthrow of the incumbent regime. With the help of the Americans, Khánh was able to rally support and the coup collapsed the next morning without any casualties. In the immediate month leading up the coup, Khánh's leadership had become increasingly troubled.

zh.s: 1964年9月13日黎明前，由阮庆将军领导的南越执政军政府面临一场政变企图。林文发和杨文明两位将军率领反对派部队进入首都西贡，占领多个要地，并通过国家电台宣布推翻现政权。在美国协助下，阮庆得以集结支持力量，政变于次日上午失败，没有造成人员伤亡。政变前一个月，阮庆的领导地位已日益不稳。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 12 and 13 September 1965. The Labour Party remained the largest party, winning 68 of the 150 seats. However, the four non-socialist parties succeeded in winning a majority between them and forming a government. Per Borten, the leader of the Centre Party, became Prime Minister.

en.s: Operation Thayer (13 September 1966 - 1 October 1966), Operation Irving (2 October 1966 - 24 October 1966) and Operation Thayer II (25 October 1966 – 12 February 1967) were related operations with the objective of eliminating communist North Vietnamese Army and Viet Cong (NVA/VC) influence in Binh Dinh province on the central coast of South Vietnam. The operations were carried out primarily by the United States 1st Cavalry Division (Airmobile) against NVA and Viet Cong regiments believed to be in Binh Dinh. South Korean and South Vietnamese forces also took part in the operation.

zh.s: 塞耶行动（1966年9月13日至10月1日）、欧文行动（1966年10月2日至24日）和塞耶二号行动（1966年10月25日至1967年2月12日）是相互关联的军事行动，目标是消除北越军和越共在南越中部沿海平定省的影响。行动主要由美国陆军第一骑兵师（空中机动）对据信驻扎在平定省的北越军和越共团级部队实施，韩国和南越部队也参与其中。

en.s: On 13 September 1971, the aircraft transporting Lin Biao, the sole vice chairman of the Chinese Communist Party, crashed near Öndörkhaan, Mongolia. Lin and several members of his family were travelling on board a Hawker Siddeley Trident jetliner of the People's Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF). All nine people on board were killed in the crash. As Vice Chairman, Lin Biao had been the official heir to Chairman Mao Zedong since 1966.

zh.s: 1971年9月13日，运送中国共产党唯一副主席林彪的飞机在蒙古温都尔汗附近坠毁。林彪及数名家人乘坐中国人民解放军空军的一架霍克·西德利三叉戟客机，机上9人全部遇难。自1966年以来，林彪一直被正式视为毛泽东的接班人。

en.t: Spantax Flight 995 crashes at Málaga Airport during a rejected takeoff, killing 50 of the 394 people on board
en.s: Spantax Flight 995 was an international charter flight from Madrid–Barajas Airport to New York via Málaga Airport. On 13 September 1982, when the DC-10 aircraft was rolling for take-off from Malaga, the pilot felt a strong and worsening vibration and aborted the take-off. The aircraft was unable to stop in the runway available and overran the runway, hitting numerous structures, crossing the nearby highway, collided with several vehicles before bursting into flames.

zh.t: 西班牙航空995号班机在马拉加机场起飞中止后冲出跑道，造成50人死亡
zh.s: 西班牙航空995号班机是一趟国际包机，从马德里巴拉哈斯机场飞往纽约，中途经停马拉加机场。1982年9月13日，DC-10客机在马拉加机场滑行准备起飞时，飞行员感到强烈且不断加剧的震动，于是中止起飞。飞机未能在剩余跑道上停下，冲出跑道，撞上多处建筑物，穿过附近公路并撞上几辆汽车，随后起火。

en.t: A magnitude 6.0 earthquake strikes Kalamata, Greece with a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme), killing at least 20 and causing heavy damage in the city
en.s: The 1986 Kalamata earthquake struck the southern Peloponnese Region of Greece on September 13 at 20:24 local time. The 12.5 km (7.8 mi) deep moment magnitude (Mw) 5.9 earthquake had an epicenter near the coastal city of Kalamata and was assigned X (Extreme) on the Mercalli intensity scale. At least 20 people died and 330 were injured; a higher death toll was prevented because many residents of Kalamata attended a ferry line opening ceremony when the earthquake struck.

zh.t: 希腊卡拉马塔发生6.0级地震，至少20人死亡，城市严重受损
zh.s: 1986年9月13日当地时间20时24分，希腊伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部发生卡拉马塔地震。震中靠近海滨城市卡拉马塔，震源深12.5公里（7.8英里），矩震级为5.9级，麦加利地震烈度达到X级（极强）。至少20人死亡、330人受伤。地震发生时，许多卡拉马塔居民正在参加一场渡轮航线开通仪式，因此避免了更高的死亡人数。

en.s: The Goiânia accident was a radioactive contamination accident that occurred on September 13, 1987, at Goiânia, in the Brazilian state of Goiás, after an old radiotherapy source was stolen from an abandoned hospital site in the city. It was subsequently handled by many people, resulting in four deaths. About 112,000 people were examined for radioactive contamination and 249 were found to have significant levels of radioactive material in or on their bodies. In the cleanup operation, topsoil had to be removed from several sites, and several houses were demolished. All the objects from within those houses were removed and examined.

zh.t: 戈亚尼亚放射性污染事故
zh.s: 戈亚尼亚事故是一起放射性污染事件，1987年9月13日发生在巴西戈亚斯州戈亚尼亚市。一家已废弃的医院里，一台旧放射治疗设备的放射源被盗，之后经多人接触，造成4人死亡。约11.2万人接受放射性污染检查，其中249人体内或身上检测到大量放射性物质。清理过程中，多个地点的表层土壤被清除，几栋房屋被拆除，屋内物品也全部搬出检查。

en.s: The 1987 Schleswig-Holstein state election was held on 13 September 1987 to elect the members of the Landtag of Schleswig-Holstein. The election resulted in a deadlock, with both the left-leaning parties (SPD and SSW) had 37 seats, and the right-leaning parties (CDU and FDP) had 37 seats, and concluded with the Barschel affair.

zh.t: 1987年石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州选举
zh.s: 石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州于1987年9月13日举行州议会选举，选出州议会议员。选举结果形成僵局：左翼政党（社民党和南石勒苏益格选民协会）共获37席，右翼政党（基民盟和自民党）也共获37席。选后发生了巴舍尔事件。

en.s: The 1987 Bremen state election was held on 13 September 1987 to elect the members of the 12th Bürgerschaft of Bremen, as well as the city councils of Bremen and Bremerhaven. The incumbent Social Democratic Party (SPD) government, led by Mayor Klaus Wedemeier, lost four seats but retained its majority. Wedemeier had become mayor following the resignation of his predecessor, Hans Koschnick, in September 1985.

zh.s: 不来梅州于1987年9月13日举行选举，选出第12届州议会议员，并选出不来梅和不来梅港的市议会成员。由市长克劳斯·韦德迈尔领导的社会民主党（SPD）现任政府少了4个席位，但仍保住多数。韦德迈尔是在前任汉斯·科施尼克于1985年9月辞职后接任市长的。

en.s: Hurricane Gilbert was a large and extremely powerful tropical cyclone that formed during the 1988 Atlantic hurricane season, which peaked as a Category 5 hurricane. The storm brought widespread destruction to the Caribbean and the Gulf of Mexico, and is tied with 1969's Hurricane Camille as the third-most intense tropical cyclone at landfall in the Atlantic Ocean.
en.n: Hurricane Gilbert is the strongest recorded hurricane in the Western Hemisphere, later replaced by Hurricane Wilma in 2005 (based on barometric pressure).

zh.s: 吉尔伯特飓风是1988年大西洋飓风季形成的一场规模庞大、威力极强的热带气旋，最高达到五级飓风强度。它给加勒比地区和墨西哥湾带来大范围破坏。在大西洋有记录的登陆热带气旋中，它与1969年的卡米尔飓风并列第三强。
zh.n: 有记录以来，吉尔伯特曾是西半球最强飓风；按气压衡量，这一纪录后来于2005年被威尔玛飓风打破。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Norway on 12 and 13 September 1993. It was the first European election where the two largest parties fielded a female leadership candidate, and the first election in history where all the largest three parties fielded female leadership candidates. The Labour Party remained the largest party in the Storting, winning 67 of the 165 seats.

zh.s: 挪威于1993年9月12日至13日举行议会选举。这是欧洲首次有两个最大政党的领导人候选人都是女性，也是历史上首次前三大党的领导人候选人全为女性。工党仍是议会第一大党，在165个席位中赢得67席。

en.s: Operation Rain (Croatian: Operacija Kiša) or the Karlovac attack (Croatian: karlovački napad) was an offensive conducted by the proto-state Serbian Krajina in September 1993. The operation was launched in retaliation to Croatian Police activity in the Medak Pocket. The attack was one of the largest conducted by the Serbian Army of Krajina (SVK) against the Croatian Army and police positions in Karlovac, specifically in Turanj.

zh.s: 雨行动（克罗地亚语：Operacija Kiša）也称卡尔洛瓦茨攻势（克罗地亚语：karlovački napad），是塞尔维亚克拉伊纳政权于1993年9月发动的一次攻势。此次行动是为报复克罗地亚警方在梅达克口袋地区的行动而发动的。塞尔维亚克拉伊纳军队（SVK）曾对卡尔洛瓦茨图拉尼一带的克罗地亚军队和警方阵地发动多次进攻，这是其中规模最大的一次。

en.s: The Oslo Accords are a pair of interim agreements between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO): the Oslo I Accord, signed in Washington, D.C., in 1993; and the Oslo II Accord, signed in Taba, Egypt, in 1995. They marked the start of the Oslo process, a peace process aimed at achieving a peace treaty based on Resolution 242 and Resolution 338 of the United Nations Security Council.

zh.s: 《奥斯陆协议》包括以色列与巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO）签署的两项临时协议：《奥斯陆一号协议》于1993年在华盛顿特区签署，《奥斯陆二号协议》于1995年在埃及塔巴签署。两项协议开启了奥斯陆进程，旨在依据联合国安理会第242号和第338号决议达成和平条约。

en.s: Unlucky Lottery was a professional wrestling live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) on September 13, 1996, the night prior to When Worlds Collide. The event was held at The Flagstaff in Jim Thorpe, Pennsylvania in the United States. A recording of the event filmed by Gabe Sapolsky was released on DVD.

zh.s: 《不幸彩票》是极限冠军摔角（ECW）于1996年9月13日举办的职业摔角现场赛事，时间是《世界相撞》前一晚。赛事在美国宾夕法尼亚州吉姆索普的弗拉格斯塔夫举办。盖布·萨波尔斯基拍摄的赛事录像后来以DVD形式发行。

en.s: On 13 September 1997, a German Air Force Tupolev Tu-154M observation aircraft and a United States Air Force Lockheed C-141B Starlifter transport aircraft struck each other mid-air while cruising at 35,000 feet (11,000 m) off the coast of Namibia. As a result of the crash, all 33 people on board both aircraft were killed and both aircraft were destroyed.

zh.s: 1997年9月13日，一架德国空军图-154M侦察机与一架美国空军C-141B“星”式运输机在纳米比亚海岸外、约3.5万英尺（1.1万米）高空巡航时相撞。两架飞机被毁，机上33人全部遇难。

en.s: General elections were held in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 12 and 13 September 1998. The elections for the House of Representatives elections were divided into two; one for the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and one for Republika Srpska. In the presidential election, each of the three national communities elected a President. Bosniaks re-elected Alija Izetbegović, Croats elected Ante Jelavić and Serbs elected Živko Radišić. The Coalition for Unity and Democracy, an alliance of the Party of Democratic Action, the Party for Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Liberal Party and the Civic Democratic Party, emerged as the largest party in the House of Representatives, winning 17 of the 42 seats.

zh.s: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那于1998年9月12日至13日举行大选。众议院选举分为波黑联邦和塞族共和国两个部分。总统选举中，三个民族共同体各自选出一名总统：波什尼亚克人连任阿利亚·伊泽特贝戈维奇，克罗地亚人选出安特·耶拉维奇，塞尔维亚人选出日夫科·拉迪希奇。由民主行动党、波黑党、自由党和公民民主党组成的团结与民主联盟成为众议院第一大党，在42个席位中赢得17席。

en.s: The 55th annual Venice International Film Festival was held between 3 and 13 September 1998. Italian filmmaker Ettore Scola was the Jury President of the Main Competition. The Golden Lion was awarded to The Way We Laughed by Gianni Amelio.

zh.t: 第55届威尼斯国际电影节
zh.s: 第55届威尼斯国际电影节于1998年9月3日至13日举行。意大利导演埃托雷·斯科拉担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。詹尼·阿梅利奥执导的《我们微笑的那条路》获金狮奖。

en.s: The 1998 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 111th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1998 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Croke Park, Dublin, on 13 September 1998, between Offaly and Kilkenny. It was the first all-Leinster All-Ireland final with victory going to Offaly managed by Michael Bond on a score line of 2-16 to 1-13.

zh.t: 1998年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1998年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛是第111届全爱尔兰决赛，也是1998年全爱尔兰高级曲棍球锦标赛的收官战。该锦标赛由爱尔兰各郡的顶级球队参加。1998年9月13日，奥法利队和基尔肯尼队在都柏林克罗克公园交手。决赛首次由伦斯特省两支球队争夺，最终由迈克尔·邦德执教的奥法利队以2比16对1比13获胜。

en.s: Fall Brawl '98: War Games was the sixth Fall Brawl professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on September 13, 1998, from the Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Nine matches were contested at the event.

zh.s: 《秋日纷争98：战争游戏》是世界冠军摔角（WCW）制作的第六届《秋日纷争》付费观看赛事，于1998年9月13日在北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆的劳伦斯·乔尔退伍军人纪念体育馆举行，共进行了九场比赛。

en.s: General elections were held in Republika Srpska on 12 and 13 September 1998. They were third parliamentary election and second presidential election in three years. Incumbent president Biljana Plavšić, who served since July 1996 after Radovan Karadžić resigned, lost to Nikola Poplašen, leader of the Serbian Radical Party of Republika Srpska. Mirko Šarović was elected Vice President.

zh.s: 塞族共和国于1998年9月12日至13日举行大选，这是三年内第三次议会选举和第二次总统选举。自1996年7月拉多万·卡拉季奇辞职后一直任职的现任总统比利亚娜·普拉夫希奇败给了塞族共和国塞尔维亚激进党领袖尼科拉·波普拉申。米尔科·沙罗维奇当选副总统。

en.t: Apartment bombing on Kashirskoye Highway in Moscow
en.s: In September 1999, a series of explosions hit four apartment blocks in the Russian cities of Buynaksk, Moscow, and Volgodonsk, killing more than 300, injuring more than 1,000, and spreading a wave of fear across the country. The bombings, together with the 1999 war of Dagestan, triggered the Second Chechen War.

zh.t: 莫斯科卡希尔公路公寓楼爆炸案
zh.s: 1999年9月，俄罗斯布伊纳克斯克、莫斯科和伏尔加顿斯克的4栋公寓楼接连发生爆炸，造成300多人死亡、1,000多人受伤，并在全国引发恐慌。这些爆炸事件与1999年达吉斯坦战争一起，成为第二次车臣战争的导火索。

en.s: The CMLL 69th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling major show event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 13, 2002 in Arena Mexico, Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the 69th anniversary of CMLL, the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world. The anniversary show is CMLL's biggest show of the year, their Super Bowl event.

zh.s: 墨西哥自由摔角委员会（CMLL）制作的成立69周年纪念赛于2002年9月13日在墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行，以纪念这家世界上历史最悠久的职业摔角推广公司成立69周年。周年纪念赛是CMLL一年中最大的一场赛事，相当于它的超级碗。

Voters in the city elected: 1 mayor 13 city council members, elected by ward 6 Minneapolis Public Library trustees 2 members of the Board of Estimate and Taxation, and 3 at-large and 6 elected by district members of the Park and Recreation Board.

en.s: The Ingush–Chechen fratricide incident on 13 September 2006 resulted in the death of eight police officers, and the wounding of a further 20 when Chechen and Ingush policemen fired on each other on the border between the republics. A motorcade of Chechnya's OMON special police buses was shot at as it was leaving Ingushetia, heading home with an Ingush prisoner.

zh.s: 2006年9月13日，印古什和车臣警员在两共和国边界互相开火，造成8名警员死亡、20人受伤。车臣OMON特种警察的车队离开印古什、载着一名印古什囚犯返家途中遭到枪击。

en.t: Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples
en.s: The United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP) was adopted by the General Assembly on Thursday, 13 September 2007, by a majority of 144 states in favour, 4 votes against (Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the United States) and 11 abstentions (Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Burundi, Colombia, Georgia, Kenya, Nigeria, Russian Federation, Samoa and Ukraine). In May 2016 Canada officially removed its objector status to UNDRIP, almost a decade after it was adopted by the General Assembly. By now also the other 3 objectors have, to various degrees, turned their vote.

zh.t: 《联合国原住民权利宣言》通过
zh.s: 2007年9月13日（星期四），联合国大会以多数票通过《联合国原住民权利宣言》。144个国家投赞成票，4个国家（澳大利亚、加拿大、新西兰和美国）投反对票，11个国家弃权（阿塞拜疆、孟加拉国、不丹、布隆迪、哥伦比亚、格鲁吉亚、肯尼亚、尼日利亚、俄罗斯、萨摩亚和乌克兰）。2016年5月，加拿大正式撤回反对立场；其余三个反对国此后也在不同程度上改变了立场。

en.t: The McLaren F1 team are found guilty of possessing confidential information from the Ferrari team, fined $100 million, and excluded from the constructors' championship standings
en.s: McLaren Racing Limited ( mə-KLARR-ən), currently competing in Formula One as McLaren Mastercard F1 Team, is a British motor racing team based at the McLaren Technology Centre in Woking, Surrey, England. The team is a subsidiary of the McLaren Group, wholly owned by Mumtalakat Holding Company. McLaren is best known as a Formula One chassis constructor, the second-oldest active team and the second-most successful Formula One team after Ferrari, having won 205 races, 13 Drivers' Championships, and 10 Constructors' Championships.

zh.t: 迈凯伦车队因持有法拉利机密信息被裁定违规，罚款1亿美元并被取消制造商积分
zh.s: 迈凯伦赛车有限公司是一支英国赛车队，目前以迈凯伦万事达卡F1车队之名参加一级方程式赛事，总部位于英格兰萨里郡沃金的迈凯伦技术中心。该队是迈凯伦集团的子公司，全部由穆巴达拉投资公司持有。迈凯伦以一级方程式赛车底盘制造商身份最为知名，是现役历史第二悠久、成绩第二成功的车队，仅次于法拉利；车队已赢得205场比赛、13个车手总冠军和10个车队总冠军。

en.s: The 13 September 2008 Delhi bombings were a series of five synchronised bomb blasts that took place within a span of few minutes on Saturday, 13 September 2008 at various locations in Delhi, India. The first bomb exploded at 18:07 IST, and four other blasts followed in succession, with at least 30 people killed and over 100 injured.

en.s: The 2008 Scottish Labour Party leadership election was an internal party election to choose a new leader of the Labour Party in the Scottish Parliament, and was triggered following the resignation of Wendy Alexander following a row over donations to her own leadership campaign in 2007. Iain Gray won the contest and was announced as leader on 13 September 2008.

zh.s: 2008年苏格兰工党党魁选举旨在选出该党在苏格兰议会的新领导人。温迪·亚历山大因2007年其党魁竞选捐款问题引发争议而辞职，触发了这次选举。伊恩·格雷胜出，并于2008年9月13日获宣布成为党魁。

en.s: The 2008 New South Wales local elections were held on 13 September 2008 to elect the councils of 150 of the 152 local government areas (LGAs) of New South Wales. Several councils also held mayoral elections and/or referendums. No elections were held in Shellharbour or Wollongong, as both councils had been sacked earlier in the year. zh.s: 新南威尔士州于2008年9月13日举行地方选举，为该州152个地方政府辖区中的150个选出地方议会。多个地方政府辖区还举行了市长选举和／或公投。谢尔哈伯和卧龙岗没有举行选举，因为两地议会都在当年早些时候被解散；这两个辖区后来于2011年举行选举。

en.t: New York's 9th congressional district special election, 2011
en.s: A 2011 special election in New York's 9th congressional district was held on September 13, 2011 to fill a seat in the U.S. Congress for New York's 9th congressional district, after Representative Anthony Weiner resigned from this seat on June 21, 2011 due to his sexting scandal. Democratic Party nominee David Weprin, a member of the New York State Assembly, faced Republican and Conservative Party nominee Bob Turner, a businessman who unsuccessfully sought the seat in 2010. The district with over 300,000 registered voters was expected to be eliminated during the 2012 redistricting.

en.s: The CMLL 80th Anniversary Show was a professional wrestling event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on September 13, 2013, in CMLL's home arena Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. The event commemorated the 80th anniversary of CMLL, the oldest professional wrestling promotion in the world. CMLL's anniversary show is their biggest, most important show of the year, comparable to the Super Bowl for the National Football League or WrestleMania for WWE. For the show CMLL decided to combine two of their biggest, longest running storyline feuds as they booked a Relevos Suicidas (Spanish for "Suicide Relay") match for the show.

en.t: 2013 attack on U.S. consulate in Herat
en.s: The U.S. consulate in Herat, Afghanistan was attacked on September 13, 2013 by a group of Taliban militants. Reports indicated that the assault began at 5:30 am on the front gate of the consulate. A large truck drove up to the Consulate's primary vehicle entry point and detonated. a massive improvised explosive charge, causing extensive damage. A minivan carrying an assault team armed with assault rifles and rocket-propelled grenades arrived and opened fire, moving into the Consulate compound. Then the driver of the minivan ignited a bomb inside the minivan, which exploded a short time afterwards.
